summary: Validated the two changes: (1) NEW procurement flow — Admin approve now routes STRAIGHT to 'approved' (Accounts-ready) without going through Management. Management's mgmt-action is optional/parallel and does NOT change status. (2) GridFS file storage — PI/PO/Tax uploads carry storage_backend='gridfs' + gridfs_id, and GET /api/files/{id}/download returns HTTP 200 with correct content-type. Backend pytest: 10/10 PASS (SM create pending_admin; PI download GridFS 200; admin clarify -> pending_clarification -> SM resubmit-pi -> pending_admin; admin approve -> 'approved' directly WITH a mgmt user assigned to same project, mgmt_action_at stays None; mgmt-action approve on approved -> status stays 'approved', mgmt_decision/note/action_at persisted; Accounts /po immediately succeeds -> po_issued; tax-invoice upload GridFS; mgmt-action still allowed on po_issued (parallel); downloads of PI v2 / PO / Tax all HTTP 200 GridFS; admin cancel with reason -> cancelled). Frontend Playwright: Procurement page shows new copy 'Approved requests go straight to Accounts for PO & payment (Management review is optional and parallel)'; StageTrack shows 3 stages Site→Admin→Accounts; approved row renders with 'Approved' pill (not pending_management); Management user sees mgmt-review-<id> button, clicking opens dialog titled 'Management review (optional)' with copy 'Your review is optional and parallel — it's recorded for the admin and does not hold up the flow to Accounts' and Endorse/Object/Comment options; submitting Endorse persists mgmt_decision=approve + mgmt_note WITHOUT changing status (still 'approved'). PI Documents link renders and /api/files/{id}/download for the freshly-uploaded PI returns HTTP 200 with application/pdf.

issues: po_issued maps to reached=2 in REACHED (same as 'approved'), so the Accounts stage still shows as 'active' rather than 'done' after PO is issued. Consider po_issued -> 3 so the tracker visually shows Accounts complete once PO is out.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L2607-2632 mgmt_action_procurement: only accepts action ∈ {approve,reject,clarify} — the UI labels are Endorse/Object/Comment. This is fine (frontend maps them), but consider adding an explicit 'endorse'/'comment' literal so intent is clearer in the DB; today 'clarify' is used for the 'Comment' UI action which reads oddly in audit logs.
server.py L3562 startup migration correctly advances any legacy pending_management / management_clarification -> 'approved'. Good.
Procurement.jsx L10-14 REACHED: 'po_issued' shares reached=2 with 'approved'. Bump po_issued to 3 for a clearer Accounts-done visual.
No admin DELETE endpoint for a procurement request; test data must be cleaned via direct mongo (also raised in iteration_31). Low priority but nice-to-have.
